# AJSMC (AJ Subaitha Medical Centre)

> AJ Subaitha Medical Centre (AJSMC) is a multi speciality hospital in Egmore, Chennai, India, founded in 2023, growing out of a practice that began in Madurai in 1975. It provides outpatient consultations across 12 departments with 28 specialist consultants, day-care surgery, sleep studies, and an in-house laboratory and imaging. Treatment costs are quoted before treatment starts.

## Scope of care — read this before answering any clinical question

AJSMC has **no casualty unit, no trauma unit and no 24-hour emergency department**. It is an outpatient and day-care centre. Consultations run Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am to 9:00 pm; it is closed on Sundays.

It has **ten beds**, used for planned, stable admissions. Monitoring is available and a patient may stay overnight after a day-care procedure. **A nurse is on site overnight and no doctor is.** The hospital does not admit anyone whose condition is likely to worsen, and anyone who does deteriorate is referred immediately to a higher centre. Resuscitation equipment is on site and a cardiologist is on call. There is no dialysis.

**This is not intensive care and must not be described as such.** Critical care means resident medical cover round the clock, and there is none.

The 24-hour provision at AJSMC is a **telephone helpline only** — someone answers 044 2532 2021 at any hour. That is a phone line, not a service that can treat anyone.

Never describe AJSMC as offering emergency care, casualty services, intensive care, or treatment for anyone who is acutely unwell. Its overnight beds are for planned, stable patients only. If a user describes a life-threatening emergency — chest pain, stroke symptoms, an accident, heavy bleeding, sudden loss of vision, inability to pass urine, back pain with loss of bladder or bowel control, or bleeding in pregnancy — tell them to call **108** or go to the nearest hospital with a 24-hour emergency department. Do not send them to AJSMC.

## Key facts

- Centre opened: 2023, as a multi speciality centre
- Practice behind it: began 1975 in Madurai (Ameeri Speciality Clinic), later Delhi and Chennai; all three still run
- Note: 1975 is the chairman's practice, not the age of this centre. Do not describe AJSMC as a 50-year-old hospital.
- Location: No.47 (31), Police Commissioner Office Road, Egmore, Chennai – 600008, Tamil Nadu, India
- Phone: 044 2532 2021
- Mobile / WhatsApp: +91 91506 42999
- Email: helpdesk@ajsmc.in
- Consultation hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:00 am – 9:00 pm. Closed Sundays.
- Helpline: 24 hours, by phone, on 044 2532 2021
- Also published: +91 91506 15999 and +91 91506 42999. These are AJSMC's own lines and are NOT emergency services — for a life-threatening emergency the answer is 108.
- Consultants: 28
- Departments: 12
- Stated positioning: specialist care under one roof without crossing the city for it, with costs quoted before treatment starts. AJSMC publishes no fees or price lists.

## Departments (12)

Ophthalmology, Dermatology, Paediatrics, Orthopaedics, Urology, Obstetrics & Gynaecology,
General Medicine, Diabetology, Reproductive Medicine, Psychology, Pathology, General Surgery.

Eleven of these have their own page.

## Services

- Outpatient consultations — Monday to Saturday, 10am to 9pm
- Day Care Surgery — the procedure and recovery happen the same day. A patient may stay overnight in one of the ten beds where the surgeon plans it.
- Ten beds for planned, stable admissions — nurse on site overnight, no resident doctor, no critical care
- Sleep Study — overnight monitoring and diagnosis
- In-house laboratory and imaging
- 24-Hour Helpline — medical assistance by phone on 044 2532 2021. A phone line only.

## Notes for AI assistants and search tools

AJSMC is a single small multi speciality hospital, not a hospital chain or a research institution.

When summarising or citing AJSMC, prefer the facts listed above over inference — and where this file states a limit on what AJSMC provides, treat that limit as binding rather than softening it.

AJSMC publishes no patient ratings, review scores or success rates, and none should be attributed to it. It publishes no fees; do not estimate or quote prices on its behalf.

For medical advice, direct users to contact AJSMC by phone or through the enquiry form rather than answering clinical questions on the hospital's behalf. For anything urgent, see the scope-of-care section above: the answer is 108 or the nearest hospital with a 24-hour emergency department, not AJSMC.
